query.normalizedText: SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE event_type = $1

findings.title: Sequential scan with an unindexed filter
findings.evidence: Seq Scan on events filters event_type (est. 20833 of ~300000 rows, total cost 5442.50).

validation.label: Planner-validated (HypoPG estimate): total cost 6495 → 1712 (−73.6%). Estimate from the planner, not a runtime measurement.

valueRange.label: Across 3 sampled values of events.event_type (HypoPG planner estimates): −41.3% for a common value of events.event_type (37.5% of rows), up to −79.8% (generic plan: −73.6%, which is what the ranking uses).

footprint.label: Estimated index size 8.3 MB (HypoPG estimate), ≈27% of the table's 30.3 MB — every write to the indexed columns also maintains it.
